nota: Tool page of the project, listed in its catalog (TOOLS) and in sitemap.xml. The page keeps its data in script constants (RAW: one row per county, one value per census year; URB: urban population; RO, RO_U, RO_R: national totals) and has one HTML table. Its JSON-LD declares the data set. No API or file download exists; no request beyond the page was made.

nota: Featured tool of the project (its home page shows it first, with 325 cities, 46 indicators and three waves). It sits on its own host. The page holds a data island (dataScript: the cities with the total score, the rank and the five category scores of each wave), script constants and an HTML table. Its JSON-LD declares the data set and six measured variables. The indicator list (INDICATOR_SET) is a literal of the page.
